meta.title: Maksym Kravchenko | CV
meta.description: Maksym Kravchenko - fullstack developer based in Thurgau, Switzerland. .NET, modern web, and self-hosted infrastructure.

hero.name: Maksym <accent>Kravchenko</accent>
hero.intro: I'm originally from Ukraine and currently based in Thurgau, Switzerland. I've been programming for almost 7 years, with nearly 3 years of hands-on experience developing and delivering real-world software projects. By day I'm a developer at Beat Bucher AG; on the side, I run Kravix Solutions, working with my own freelance clients.

bullets: Building and maintaining internal applications for the marketing department
Developing full-stack features for a new version of the company web shop
Developing a new CMS from scratch to manage all Firm's data
Daily database work: modelling, querying and operating production data
Working with GitHub Actions for zero-downtime CI/CD
Testing and code reviews to keep the codebase and architecture clean and maintainable
Implement Figma designs and support colleagues with day-to-day IT

kravix.lead: A small software studio building client web apps and self-hosted infrastructure. Marketing sites, production Kubernetes, and most things in between.
kravix.more: See all projects on the <accentStrong>Kravix Solutions</accentStrong> website

kinetika.title: Kinetika
kinetika.desc: Portfolio web app for a Swiss photo studio, powered by a bespoke headless CMS (builded by myself) for instant content changes without redeploys. Dockerized, multilingual.

k8s.title: Self-hosted Kubernetes platform
k8s.desc: Rancher-managed cluster with a GitHub Actions pipeline building & publishing to GHCR, zero-downtime rolling deployments, and Prometheus/Grafana observability.
